name: save-boot-7-world-kalm
description: #80, world map: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-wm1-kalm.json: module state 3 (world map) with exit action 0, and location 2 (wm1, 'Outside Kalm' in ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID); party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; progress 6 (md1stin's value: no reachable source documents the progress value here). In the decomp (reference only) the title's load copies the state into g_GameState and the exit action into the world map's entry argument, so the world map starts at that entry point, as when a field exit leads there. Load as save-boot-1-load does, but wait for g_GameState 3 (w_state). Then 600 frames for the world map to load, 60 frames of Up, 60 of Right and 30 still. Checks: g_GameState still reads 3 (world_ok); g_FieldCurrentMap still names the entry point (map_ok); the world overlay has set its player actor pointer D_8010AD40 to pool element 7 (pc_ok: low half 0xA554, measured in attempts 2 and 3), so the world module itself is running; and a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state (match). Not checked: that the pad moves the party. In attempt 3 element 7's pos.vx/vz did not change over that input (notes/80-boot-catalogue.md; follow-up issue). Reported: wm_id (0 = the main world map).

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; field 1, battle 2, menu 5 confirmed #76).

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): in the world map, the entry point the save names.

wm_id.description: World overlay D_800E5634 (WmGetWmId; s32, low half): which world map runs, 0 = the main map. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c, config/symbols.world.txt.

pc_lo.description: World overlay D_8010AD40, the player actor pointer (low half): which element of the actor pool D_80109F34[] (0xE0 bytes each, low halves 0x9F34 + i*0xE0) is the player. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h.
